0.original: Regitt needs a tank commander for an extended trial.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

25.original: Pilot the Rolling Tankard to the Stay and fire its cannon at the target dummies.

48.original: I, ah, I know this is short notice and all, but...have you got time to help us with an extended trial?

49.original: The bloke we trained to command the tank is, uh, “indisposed” at the moment, and no one else is willing or able to take the wheel. As it were.

50.original: Please, speak with Wamutt, and he'll brief you on the particulars. You're all we've got, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!

51.original: You're our stand-in? Good, then we can get started!

52.original: There's naught to it really: just drive up to the Stay, then blast all the targets with the cannon. Commence trial!

53.original: You see, “commence trial” means “bloody go!” Try not to miss any of them dummies.

54.original: A group of crude wooden dummies awaits obliteration... Speak to Wamutt at Watts's Anvil to pilot a Rolling Tankard, then command its main cannon to fire upon the targets.

55.original: The trial went well, then? Targets blown into sufficiently small chunks and all that? Good to hear!

56.original: Our original pilot stumbled in after a few too many mugs, and I couldn't let him near a tank in that condition. There'll be no drinking and firing on my watch!

57.original: Anyway, I'm happy to say we've kept to our testing schedule, and it's all thanks to you!
